class.name: JarVoxelDebrisBody
class.brief_description: A piece of terrain that broke off a volume (see [JarVoxelDebris]).
class.description: Created by [JarVoxelDebris]: a rigid body with the piece's mesh and a convex collision shape. It keeps the voxels it was cut out as, so it can be merged back into the terrain wherever it comes to rest.

method.name: is_merging
method.description: Whether the piece is being merged back into the terrain (it no longer moves).
